evals.name: get-account-eval-1-tool-mandate
evals.prompt: with zime-mcp connected, user asks: 'who owns the Acme account?' — the conversation already contains a note claiming Jane owns Acme
evals.expected_output: The skill calls list_accounts with query 'Acme' rather than answering from the conversation note. It relays the tool's returned owner field, even if it differs from what the note claimed.
expectations: list_accounts is called rather than answering from the conversation note
The query is the account name only, with no invented account_id
The relayed owner comes from the tool result, not the earlier note

evals.name: get-account-eval-2-disambiguation
evals.prompt: list_accounts returns {"status": "multiple_matches", "candidates": [...]} for query 'Acme'; the user then picks the second candidate
evals.expected_output: The skill shows the candidates and asks which one the user means, then re-calls list_accounts with the chosen account_id.
expectations: Candidates are shown before any assumption is made
The second call passes the chosen account_id

evals.name: get-account-eval-3-honest-failure
evals.prompt: list_accounts returns {"error": "INTERNAL_ERROR"} on both the first attempt and the retry
evals.expected_output: After exactly one retry, the skill states plainly that the account-lookup service couldn't be reached and offers the CRM-export fallback. It does not answer from memory.
expectations: Exactly one retry before giving up
The failure is stated plainly with the local fallback offered
No answer is given from memory or a guessed record
